Project Description: Plantira is a web application that provides users with information about different plants, including their care instructions, growth patterns, and ideal growing conditions. The application aims to help plant enthusiasts and gardeners make informed decisions about plant care and maintenance.

Saha is a social networking platform that connects people with similar interests and hobbies. The platform allows users to create profiles, join groups, and participate in discussions related to their favorite activities. Saha aims to foster a sense of community and encourage users to share their experiences and knowledge.

Clokk is a time management and productivity application that helps users track their tasks, set reminders, and monitor their progress. The application provides users with insights into their work habits and helps them optimize their time for better efficiency.
